metadata.description: Wrangl: Agent Hierarchy, a multi-agent role hierarchy for Claude Code, driven by the ahd daemon.

plugins.name: wrangl
plugins.description: Wrangl: Agent Hierarchy. Turns one Claude Code session into a team of agent roles (an Orchestrator that dispatches an Architect, Implementor, Reviewer and others), each on the right model, coordinated by a local daemon. Commands: ah and ahd. Disable or uninstall ah (v1) before enabling Wrangl; running both in one session doubles every hook. State lives in ~/.claude/ah2 and <repo>/.claude/ah2.
